options.text: Access should follow role and need, not be uniform by default
options.rationale: Correct: least-privilege access reduces risk; uniform access ignores role differences.

options.text: Roles do not exist in team plans
options.rationale: Roles and access controls are part of administration.

items.stem: Which TWO belong in data governance for an enterprise rollout? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Defining what data may and may not be used with Claude
options.rationale: Correct: scoping in-bounds data is core governance.

options.text: Setting retention and data-handling controls deliberately
options.rationale: Correct: controls should be chosen to meet obligations, not left to default.
Defaults may not match the organisation's requirements.

options.text: Letting each user decide their own retention
